page.notes: The woodcut device between "Rectore." and "FRANCOFVRTI," (Pegasus with caduceus, cornucopia and two Hermes-style staves on clouds) is an illustration and is not transcribed. Handwritten pencil/ink mark "p. 7058" at the lower right, and the marginal pencil marks at the left edge, are handwriting and are not transcribed. Printed text is set in large roman capitals and italics; the line "Quæ" and the line "PHYSIOLOGIA GENERALIS" use a decorative initial P in the scan, transcribed as P. Some letters are uncertain due to scan contrast: "plerarumq;" and "tædium" are read with [?] omitted because they are clearly legible at this resolution.
